Example for Real-Time Pricing

® Anewprice every 15 minutes

® Consumption within the agreed reference quantity (yellow) = agreed price
® Consumption outsidethe agreedreference quantity (red) = spot price

Process Flow

IS-U-EDM allows you to prepare for RTP billing. An internal interface transfers prepared RTP data to the IS-U billing component.
Unlike conventional IS-U billing, RTP billing allows you to bill very small units of time (such as data from 15-minute intervals). These
units of time correspond to the time units of the interval data measured.

1 Note

You can find further information about RTP billing in Customizing under |SAP Utilities > Energy Data Management >
Interface to RTP Billing } General Information on the RTP Interface. 3

Formulas

Formulas define the calculations that take place when an RTP interface is executed. You allocate a formula to an RTP interface.
When you choose a formula, you define input parameters to be supplied to the RTP interface as well as the output parameters

available.
